story.originalTitle: F1 Dutch GP: Norris overhauls Antonelli for victory, Verstappen suffers heavy crash
story.summaryEn: Formula 1 world champion Lando Norris produced a mega drive to win the Dutch Grand Prix from pole while home hero Max Verstappen caused a red flag by crashing out. The McLaren driver crossed the line 11.5s ahead of runner-up Kimi Antonelli, with his Mercedes team-mate George Russell completing the podium at Zandvoort.
detailZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：诺里斯超越安东内利夺冠，维斯塔潘严重撞车
兰多·诺里斯在F1荷兰大奖赛与基米·安东内利的较量中胜出，取得连续第二场胜利
F1世界冠军兰多·诺里斯奉献了一场精彩绝伦的驾驶，从杆位出发赢得荷兰大奖赛，而主场英雄马克斯·维斯塔潘因撞车退赛引发红旗。
这位迈凯伦车手以11.5秒的优势领先亚军基米·安东内利冲过终点线，其梅赛德斯队友乔治·拉塞尔在赞德沃特登上领奖台最后一席。
此前，诺里斯在排位赛中力压冲刺赛冠军拉塞尔夺得杆位，安东内利位列第三，他们和其余车手一样，尽管发车前一小时有雨，仍使用干胎起步。
但雨水时断时续，造成湿干交替的路面，其危险在首圈结束时显现——诺里斯起步完美，而安东内利在第1弯超越拉塞尔。
这是因为维斯塔潘在最后一弯内侧将轮胎压到白线上，导致这位红牛车手打滑撞向护栏，碎片散落在赛道上。
“是的，就这样——抱歉！”这位荷兰车手通过车队无线电说道，他引发的红旗恰逢加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托也在倾斜弯道处发生360度打转，但不知何故避免了损伤。
随后又是一次静止起步——此前奥利弗·贝尔曼在编队圈遭遇引擎故障——这次令诺里斯沮丧，因为安东内利在第1弯挤过他以取得领先。
尽管迈凯伦使用软胎而安东内利使用中性胎，后者可谓双喜临门，因为争冠对手拉塞尔在第7弯将第三位输给了使用硬胎的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里。
拉塞尔就是没有速度，很快受到夏尔·勒克莱尔的压力，他报告了平衡问题，但狭窄的赛道让他得以坚守，直到第18圈将中性胎换成硬胎。
迈凯伦上一圈让皮亚斯特里进站回应，但事与愿违，一次缓慢的5.4秒停站让他落在拉塞尔之后，而安东内利此时已在前方领先诺里斯2.2秒。
进站窗口过后——所有领先车手除勒克莱尔使用中性胎外均选择硬胎——这一差距缩小到一秒，但卫冕冠军难以进一步逼近。
轮对轮的较量在更靠后的位置更为频繁：角田裕毅在一场争夺前十的多车混战中胜出，而勒克莱尔则一直紧咬皮亚斯特里。
这场小较量最终在第34圈结束，法拉利和迈凯伦在开局几个弯道并驾齐驱，勒克莱尔最终在第3弯外侧超越取得第四。
皮亚斯特里的苦难还未结束，下一圈他在第1弯被刘易斯·汉密尔顿超越跌至第五，后者迅速逼近队友勒克莱尔。
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
这位七届世界冠军试图寻求车队指令，但指令并未到来，汉密尔顿讽刺地告诉法拉利车队：“浪费时间的绝佳方式，伙计们，干得好！”
汉密尔顿最终在勒克莱尔第43圈第二次进站后完成超越，勒克莱尔比梅赛德斯双雄晚两圈进站，比诺里斯进站换另一套硬胎早五圈。
但法拉利让汉密尔顿留在外面，使他占据赛道上的第一名，然而净领先位置的争夺在其身后展开，诺里斯迅速逼近安东内利，后者抱怨其后轮倍耐力轮胎。
于是到第54圈，汉密尔顿、安东内利和诺里斯都在一秒之内，卫冕世界冠军在第1弯外侧对安东内利完成了一次大范围超越。
就在同一圈，诺里斯随后在第11弯从汉密尔顿手中取得实际领先，汉密尔顿下一圈在第1弯落到安东内利之后——恰逢埃斯特班·奥康在第4弯停车引发虚拟安全车。
“你们把我当小白鼠吗，”汉密尔顿抱怨道，他想要进站，最终在虚拟安全车下进站换上软胎——安东内利同样如此，而诺里斯和此时升至第二的拉塞尔则留在外面使用硬胎。
诺里斯承认他对这一决定感到“担忧”，而且有理由如此，因为更新轮胎的优势显而易见，安东内利迅速缩小了与拉塞尔的差距。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
梅赛德斯最终告诉这位英国人让队友通过，交换在第65圈第1弯完成，但这让拉塞尔暴露在汉密尔顿的威胁之下，他声称“我们丢掉了双领奖台”。
但拉塞尔坚守住了，得益于第70圈因第5弯碎片而短暂出现的虚拟安全车，他取得最后一个领奖台席位，落后安东内利4.3秒，落后诺里斯15.8秒，后者取得2026年第二场胜利。
汉密尔顿获得第四，勒克莱尔第五，皮亚斯特里第六，红牛替补利亚姆·劳森、奥迪的尼科·霍肯伯格、阿斯顿·马丁的费尔南多·阿隆索和阿尔派的皮埃尔·加斯利分别位列前十。
这一结果扩大了安东内利的冠军优势，这位19岁车手离开荷兰时以59分领先并列第二的拉塞尔和汉密尔顿。
detailEn: F1 Dutch GP: Norris overhauls Antonelli for victory, Verstappen suffers heavy crash
Lando Norris came out on top in a battle at the F1 Dutch GP against Kimi Antonelli to take his second, consecutive win
Formula 1 world champion Lando Norris produced a mega drive to win the Dutch Grand Prix from pole while home hero Max Verstappen caused a red flag by crashing out.
The McLaren driver crossed the line 11.5s ahead of runner-up Kimi Antonelli, with his Mercedes team-mate George Russell completing the podium at Zandvoort.
It came after Norris pipped sprint winner Russell for pole ahead of third-placed Antonelli and they all, like the rest of the grid, started on slicks despite rain an hour before lights out.
But the rain was on and off causing a wet-dry surface, the dangers of which emerged at the end of the opening lap once Norris had a perfect getaway while Antonelli overtook Russell at Turn 1.
That’s because Verstappen dipped a tyre onto the white line on the inside of the final corner, causing the Red Bull driver to spin into the barrier which spread debris on the circuit.
“Yeah that’s it - sorry!,” said the Dutchman via team radio, having brought out the red flag just as Gabriel Bortoleto also had a 360-degree spin at the banking but somehow avoided damage.
So another standing start followed - after Oliver Bearman suffered an engine failure on the formation tour - and much to Norris’ dismay this time, as Antonelli squeezed by at Turn 1 for the lead.
That was despite softs on the McLaren compared to mediums for Antonelli, who essentially had a double delight as title rival Russell lost third to hard runner Oscar Piastri at Turn 7.
Russell just didn’t have the pace, soon being pressurised by Charles Leclerc as he reported balance problems, but the tight track allowed him to hold firm before swapping mediums for hards on lap 18.
McLaren responded the previous lap with Piastri, but this backfired as a slow 5.4s stop put him behind Russell just as Antonelli had streaked 2.2s clear of Norris out front.
That gap closed to a second once the pit window - where all the frontrunners chose hard tyres bar Leclerc on mediums - had passed, yet the reigning champion struggled to make inroads.
The wheel-to-wheel battles were more prevalent lower down: Yuki Tsunoda came out on top in a mega multi-car fight for the top 10, while Leclerc was constantly on Piastri’s tail.
That little battle finally ended on lap 34 when the Ferrari and McLaren went through the opening corners wheel-to-wheel, only for Leclerc to edge by for fourth around the outside of Turn 3.
There was yet more misery for Piastri as he was overtaken for fifth at Turn 1 on the following tour by Lewis Hamilton, who quickly closed in on team-mate Leclerc.
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
The seven-time world champion was angling for team orders but they did not arrive and Hamilton sarcastically told his Ferrari squad: “Great way of wasting time guys, good job!”
Hamilton eventually moved by though once Leclerc made his second pitstop on lap 43, two tours after the Mercedes duo, and five before Norris came in for another set of hard tyres.
But Ferrari kept Hamilton out which left him with first on track, yet the battle for the net lead emerged behind as Norris rapidly closed on Antonelli, who complained about his rear Pirellis.
So come lap 54 Hamilton, Antonelli and Norris were all within a second and the reigning world champion made a sweeping move on Antonelli around the outside of Turn 1.

It was that same lap that Norris subsequently took the actual lead at Turn 11 from Hamilton, who dropped behind Antonelli at Turn 1 the following lap - just as Esteban Ocon caused a virtual safety car by stopping at Turn 4.

“Are you using me as a guinea pig,” complained Hamilton, wanting to pit, and that he finally did under the VSC by taking softs - likewise for Antonelli, while Norris and now second-placed Russell stayed out on hard rubber.
Norris admitted he was “worried” by that decision and had reasons to be so, as the advantage of the fresher tyre became evident with Antonelli quickly reducing his gap to Russell.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, George Russell, Mercedes
Mercedes eventually told the Briton to let his team-mate by with the swap occurring at Turn 1 on lap 65, but this left Russell vulnerable against Hamilton, claiming “we’ve lost a double podium”.
But Russell held firm, helped by a brief VSC on lap 70 for debris at Turn 5, to take the final podium spot, 4.3s behind Antonelli and 15.8s off Norris who took his second win of 2026.

Hamilton finished fourth, Leclerc took fifth and Piastri was sixth, while Red Bull stand-in Liam Lawson, Audi’s Nico Hulkenberg, Aston Martin’s Fernando Alonso and Alpine’s Pierre Gasly respectively completed the top 10.
The result has extended Antonelli’s championship advantage, as the 19-year-old leaves the Netherlands with a 59-point lead over both Russell and Hamilton in second.

detailZh: 阿尔派的2024年F1赛车部件即将变身终极收藏品展示。F1 Authentics，F1的官方纪念品平台，将开始拍卖一个2024年赛事使用的变速箱载体，配以带有工作DRS襟翼的赛事规格后翼，安装在定制的展示架上。
从阿尔派 2024年Formula 1赛车中使用的变速箱载体被配对了一个带有工作DRS襟翼的赛事规格后翼，形成了一个不同寻常的收藏品展示。
赛车文化不仅限于赛道。它包括车手的生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计以及那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
阿尔派 2024年Formula 1赛车的一部分即将进行拍卖，并且已经被改造成可以放在你客厅的东西。
F1 Authentics，F1官方纪念品平台，正在开启对一款非常酷的2024年赛事使用的变速箱载体以及与其配套的赛车规格后翼的竞拍。变速箱载体上仍保留着其原始的FIA封印，而该翼保留了可工作的DRS襟翼。
这可能会成为你在凝视窗外，一边喝着早晨的咖啡一边沉思时可以依靠的不可思议的东西。
这个组合，是‘奥斯汀拍卖’的一部分，标题为BWT 阿尔派 Formula 1 Team 2024 Race-Used Gearbox Carrier & Rear Wing Assembly。其中只有变速箱载体被描述为赛事使用，而后翼是赛车规格部件。
由碳纤维和金属制成，变速箱载体构成了汽车后结构的一部分，而其上方的翼，仍然保持着阿尔派的粉色和蓝色BWT涂装，并在翼尖上印有Castrol品牌，负责管理空气流动并在汽车后部产生下压力。
DRS襟翼仍然可以打开和关闭。当你有访客时，这将是一场令人难以置信的展示。
埃斯蒂班·奥康，阿尔派，皮埃尔·加斯利，阿尔派
虽然2024年对阿尔派来说并不是一个完美的赛季，但它确实为当时的全法阵容带来了双料领奖台。
在艰难的开局之后，车队在车手积分榜上排名第六，得益于圣保罗大奖赛上的雨战，埃斯蒂班·奥康获得第二名，皮埃尔·加斯利获得第三名。
detailEn: Alpine's 2024 F1 car has been turned into the ultimate collector's display
A race-used gearbox carrier from Alpine's 2024 Formula 1 car has been paired with a race-spec rear wing featuring a working DRS flap for an unusual collector's display
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
A piece of Alpine's 2024 Formula 1 car is about to go up for auction, and it has been turned into something you could actually put in your living room.

F1 Authentics, the official memorabilia platform of F1, is opening bidding on a very cool 2024 race-used gearbox carrier paired with a race-spec rear wing, mounted together on a custom-built display stand. The gearbox carrier still carries its original FIA seal, and the wing keeps a working DRS flap.
It could make for an incredible thing to lean on while you look soulfully out of the window drinking your morning coffee.

The lot, that makes up part of 'The Austin Auction,' is titled the BWT Alpine Formula 1 Team 2024 Race-Used Gearbox Carrier & Rear Wing Assembly. Only the gearbox carrier is described as race-used; the rear wing is a race-specification part.

Made from carbon fibre and metal, the gearbox carrier forms part of the car's rear structure while the wing above it, still in Alpine's pink-and-blue BWT livery with Castrol branding on the endplates, manages airflow and creates downforce at the rear of the car.
The DRS flap can still be opened and closed. And what an incredible showing that would be for when you have visitors.
Esteban Ocon, Alpine, Pierre Gasly, Alpine
While 2024 wasn't the perfect season for Alpine, it did result in a double podium for the then-all-French lineup.
After a difficult start, the team finished sixth in the constructors' standings, helped by a wet race at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, where Esteban Ocon finished second and Pierre Gasly third.

detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿的巴西大奖赛帽子揭幕，发布日期确认
法拉利为刘易斯·汉密尔顿揭幕了一款特别的巴西主题帽子，他将佩戴这款帽子参加2026年的巴西大奖赛
法拉利车迷们。最新的法拉利F1车队新闻，车手更新，技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远地方的赛事反应
法拉利揭幕了一款巴西主题帽子，刘易斯·汉密尔顿将在巴西大奖赛中佩戴，粉丝们可以在比赛前几天购买自己的帽子。
Maranello车队与Puma在10月16日通过Instagram联合发布了这款帽子。"莱维斯将在Interlagos赛道上戴上带着一小块巴西元素的帽子。而且它很快也将属于你。将于11月3日开始发售，"车队在展示七届冠军戴着新设计的帽子的照片时写道。
这款帽子以大胆的黄色为主题，细节处有磨损效果，露出下面的绿色，反映了巴西国旗的颜色。法拉利标志以银色突出地放置在前面，与银色的Puma标志相匹配，缝制在帽檐右侧。
"给我来一顶吧，莱维斯先生，"一位粉丝评论道，另一位粉丝补充说："我甚至不是法拉利的粉丝，但这真的很酷。我也想戴。"
其他人质疑这款帽子是否是法拉利车手将在Interlagos赛事中引入类似特殊头盔的信号。
汉密尔顿于2022年11月正式成为巴西的荣誉公民。
"我想对在这里的每一个人说声大大的谢谢，对于那些为了让这一天成为可能而搬山填海的人，" 41岁的汉密尔顿当时说。"这对我来说真的是一种巨大的荣誉，能够在这里接受和接受这个公民身份。我真的感觉现在我是你们中的一员，终于。
"当我2007年第一次来到这里[汉密尔顿的第一个F1赛季]，这里的爱是如何增长的，我们共同的经历，尤其是2021年[他向胜利发起冲击]，知道你们一直在我身后为我加油，这是我一生中最特别的时刻之一。我迫不及待地想要继续努力向前。
"我真的很想将今天，这个荣誉，献给埃尔顿·塞纳——献给埃尔顿的家庭，他的朋友和他的粉丝。对我来说，当我五岁的时候，我第一次看到埃尔顿赛车，那就是我知道我想要成为世界冠军，就像他一样。
“那时我才知道并了解了巴西。那时我开始以巴西队的身份玩FIFA！但实际上，通过他的眼睛，我看到了巴西人有多么热情，这种热爱和激情有多深，你对国家的热爱有多么美好。我非常兴奋能在这里多待一些时间。”
2026年巴西大奖赛将于11月6日至8日举行，这将是一个三连赛的一部分，从10月23日至25日的美国大奖赛开始，接着是10月30日至11月1日的墨西哥大奖赛。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton's Brazilian GP cap unveiled with release date confirmed
Ferrari has unveiled a special Brazil-themed cap for Lewis Hamilton to wear at the 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Ferrari has revealed a Brazil-themed cap that Lewis Hamilton will wear at the Brazilian Grand Prix, and fans will be able to buy their own a few days before the race.

The Maranello outfit announced the cap in a joint Instagram post with Puma on 16 October. "Lewis will be wearing a small piece of Brazil with him at Interlagos. And it can also be yours soon. Available to buy on November 3rd," the team wrote alongside photos of the seven-time champion wearing the new design.

The cap features a bold yellow theme with distressed detailing that reveals green underneath, reflecting the colours of the Brazilian flag. The Ferrari logo is prominently placed on the front in silver, with a matching silver Puma logo embroidered on the front right of the bill.
"Give me one right now, Sir Lewis Hamilton," one fan commented, while another added: "I'm not even a Ferrari fan, but that is slick. I'd wear it."
Others questioned whether the cap could be a sign that the Ferrari driver will introduce a similar special helmet for the race at Interlagos.
Hamilton officially became an honorary citizen of Brazil in November 2022.

"I’d like to say a big, big thank you to everyone here at the house, for all those who’ve moved mountains to make this day possible," the 41-year-old said at the time. "It is honestly the greatest honour for me to be here receiving and accepting this citizenship. I really do feel like now I’m one of you, finally.

"When I arrived here in 2007 [Hamilton’s first F1 season], the love that’s grown, the experiences we’ve had and, particularly 2021 [his charge to victory], knowing you guys were cheering me on the way, it was one of the most special moments of my entire life. I can’t wait for us to continue to strive ahead.

"I really want to dedicate today, this honour, to Ayrton Senna – to Ayrton’s family, to his friends and to his fans. For me, when I was five years old, I saw Ayrton race for the first time, and that was the moment I knew that I wanted to be a world champion, just like him.

"It was then that I knew and learnt about Brazil. It was then that I started to play FIFA as Brazil! But really, through his eyes, I was able to see how passionate Brazilians were, and how deep it goes, the love and passion you have for your country, and how beautiful it is. I’m so excited to spend some more time here."

The 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix is scheduled for 6-8 November and will round out a triple-header starting with the United States Grand Prix from 23-25 October followed by the Mexican Grand Prix from 30 October to 1 November.
